entries:
Alpha 1.11.0 (Lanternhold takes shape)

  • Crafted town surfaces: Weathered masonry, layered slate courses and subtle timber grain replace flat building surfaces. Town and Earth ground now have generated normal/roughness detail, with cooler shadows against warm lanterns.
  • Leaves, not solid crowns: Ossuary birches have folded leaf geometry and varied color. Spatial rendering groups cull distant detailed trees without changing tree placement or collision.
  • Better-fitting shoulders: Steel and reinforced pauldrons use smaller hollow shells, overlapping plates and contrasting rims on the existing animated equipment anchors.
  • Casino maps match the venue: Maps use the expanded floor size, current-floor stations and guest markers, five distinct game symbols, correct guard/exit/stair positions and VIP access state. The upstairs minimap points downstairs instead of showing the public exit.
  • The road to beta: The 1.11–1.99 roadmap now includes meaningful populated locations, exploration activities and a world-map overhaul before closed beta. This release begins that visual work; it does not claim the complete world redesign or beta readiness.
  • Progress preserved: No changes to combat stats, rewards, currencies, saved quests or casino rules. The physical Dark Realm portal and remaining casino performance work are later milestones, not features shipped here. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.10.2 (Resilient administration history)

  • Recoverable read history: Administration status, online-player and history requests retain their audit entries during temporary audit-database outages, using the existing recovery journal.
  • Permissions stay strict: Failed audit writes still withhold privileged results. If both database and local storage fail, the connection closes and recovery remains pending; forced process loss can still lose entries held only in memory.
  • No gameplay changes: Combat, progression, rewards, saved characters, casino rules and currencies are unchanged. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.10.1 (Clearer victories)

  • Cleaner notifications: Story, victory and encounter notices no longer show an empty Attack power row. Normal enemy targeting restores its combat information.
  • Readable phone titles: Notification titles wrap instead of cutting off important words, in portrait and landscape. Ordinary enemy target cards remain compact.
  • Progress stays intact: No changes to rewards, combat stats, saved characters, currencies or the 15-minute dungeon logout rule.
  • Verification update: Group checks now cover all four elemental crystal-repair raids and the Umbral Nexus. A five-player Dark King victory and all five survivors' manual rewards, epilogues and relogin persistence are confirmed through the prepared encounter and its saved continuation. These checks use prepared parties and retained campaign progress; uninterrupted fresh-campaign and human pacing checks remain open. This is not exhaustive campaign sign-off. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.10.0 (The Resonant Age)

  • A complete world to playtest: The Fourfold Chronicle spans elemental investigations, dungeon clears, four defended crystal-repair raids and the level-100 Dark Realm expedition, Umbral Nexus and four-Eidolon Dark King finale. Ilyra's quests require explicit acceptance and manual turn-ins. Earlier releases' party, visual, mobile, casino and administration improvements are included.
  • A clearer leveling journey: New story offers provide preparation XP for the next area's enemies and dungeon entry. Repeatable combat and daily XP are balanced alongside those one-time rewards. The design targets are 2–3 hours to the first dungeon, roughly 100 hours to level 100, and another 8–12 hours in the Dark Realm; these are playtest targets, not measured guarantees.
  • Reachable long-term forging: Potency prices through +8 are unchanged. Later upgrades grow more gradually so every step through +20 can be paid from a normal inventory. +20 remains a long-term endgame investment, not expected story gear. Forge previews and server costs agree.
  • A tighter finale: New Dark King encounters have a smaller health pool to target a 5–10-minute five-player fight and bring the Eidolons' interventions into reach sooner. His damage, telegraphs and four phases are unchanged; party playtesting will guide further tuning.
  • Your progress stays yours: Existing levels, XP, Gold, gear and accepted reward quotes are preserved. Level-cap quest XP continues as Resonance XP. Town healing, Well Rested, latest-cleared-boss returns and the 15-minute dungeon logout rule remain in place. EP remains separate from Gold and cannot buy gameplay power.
  • Alpha playtest: Please report awkward controls, encounter difficulty and progression pacing. The latest five-player finale test reached phase III but did not clear the Dark King; raid acceptance remains open. Physical-phone party/dungeon feedback and comprehensive human campaign timing remain open; this release does not claim those measurements are complete. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.9.31 (resonance in step)

  • Live Resonance progress: At level 100, Resonance XP now updates during ordinary combat and dungeon room rewards without reopening a menu or relogging. Changed ranks and available points use the same synchronization. Reward amounts and saved progress are unchanged.
  • Clearer event combat: On larger desktop screens, public-event instructions sit below the minimap instead of covering the central aiming area. The panel remains collapsible, and compact phone layouts are preserved.
  • Campaign work continues: The four-player Molten clear and saved Air handoff have passed. Remaining campaign, raid, finale and progression-balance work is still underway; this is not the final 1.10 sign-off. Earlier patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.30 (beyond the four lanterns)

  • The Dark Realm opens: At level 100, after manually completing all four crystal repairs, speak to the Dungeon Guide to enter a shared expedition zone. Recover at the Resonant Foothold with town-style healing and Well Rested, then explore the Unwritten Shore, Tithe of Names, Stillwater Foundry and City Without Tomorrow.
  • A longer Fourfold Chronicle: 24 new chapters and 38 discoveries reveal the people behind Malachar's promises. Investigate records, fight collectors and recover four new personal quest items with bag icons. Ilyra offers and completes chapters through explicit conversations; Maelin and five other residents have optional, discovery-led dialogue.
  • A road to the throne: New entrants must complete the expedition before entering the Umbral Nexus, whose clear leads to the Dark King's raid. Existing accepted Nexus or finale contracts retain their access at level 100; missing added chapters are optional for those veterans, never automatically completed. The map marks accepted discoveries and Recall returns you to Lanternhold.
  • Progression tuning: Incoming combat XP and newly offered daily-quest XP are lower, targeting approximately 100 hours to level 100. Saved levels, XP, gear, Gold and accepted reward quotes are preserved. Quest XP still becomes Resonance XP at level 100. The 100-hour and additional 8–12-hour Dark Realm targets are estimates under continued tuning, not measured guarantees.
  • Reliable return: Ilyra's expedition projection stays available, and Recall/re-entry synchronizes movement so approaching her and turning in quests works correctly. Admin visits inside the shared realm respect personal entry requirements and actual scenery. Private dungeon and raid checkpoints and the 15-minute logout expiry are unchanged.
  • Release identity: The published browser manifest now takes its version from the same release file as the project, preventing an outdated deployment label from disagreeing with the login screen.
  • Integration continues: The opening expedition chapter and fresh-character opening have passed connected checks; the complete campaign, remaining raids and final pacing still need acceptance. This is not the final 1.10 sign-off. Earlier patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.29 (hold the ground you earned)

  • Boss checkpoints: Returning from town to an active dungeon or raid now places you at the latest cleared boss checkpoint. Before the first boss clear, you return to the entrance. The Dungeon Guide explains the return rule.
  • Your party keeps its progress: Re-entry preserves cleared encounters and rewards, does not skip uncleared rooms, and leaves teammates already inside in place. Scene loading uses the server's actual checkpoint position.
  • Existing limits remain: The 15-minute logout expiry and active-run reset rules are unchanged. This release does not rebalance XP or add the planned expanded Dark Realm story; those remain part of the ongoing 1.10 work. Earlier patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.28 (the same foes await)

  • Consistent restored encounters: Current seeded dungeon and raid runs now restore the original enemy pack composition, placement and combat profiles after a server restart, instead of substituting generic room packs.
  • Saved progress stays yours: Cleared rooms stay cleared. Saved geometry, quest credit and the 15-minute logout expiry are unchanged. Older or unmatched layouts retain their compatible restoration path; no boss health or damage tuning is included.
  • Integration continues: Full campaign and raid acceptance remain in progress; this is not the final 1.10 sign-off. Earlier patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.27 (back where you belong)

  • Reliable dungeon reconnects: Returning to an active dungeon or raid now carries your saved landing position through scene loading, preventing an intermittent reset to the entrance that could separate party members.
  • Your run rules stay the same: The existing 15-minute logout expiry, uncleared encounter restoration, resources and quest rewards are unchanged. This update does not grant dungeon completion or change boss balance.
  • Integration continues: Full campaign and raid acceptance remain in progress; this is not the final 1.10 sign-off. Earlier patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.26 (the right moment to answer)

  • Service hints keep pace: Interaction distance hints refresh as you walk, even when the pointer stays still. Entering or leaving an instance clears old town prompts and cursor highlights.
  • Meet Orun at the encounter: The Dark King's opening Eidolon callout now waits until a living raider approaches the encounter, instead of playing at the distant entrance portal. Later phase aid and boss combat balance are unchanged.
  • Integration continues: Earned campaign and full raid checks remain in progress; this is not the final 1.10 sign-off. All earlier patch notes remain available.
